title: Collections Standard: Late Fees in a Delinquency Cycle with Gate Lockout or Tow Notices, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Standard.** A late fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is multiplied by 1.5 where a notice of intent to tow has been sent in the current delinquency cycle, and by 1.25 where no such notice has been sent in the cycle but a gate lockout notice has. Where neither has been sent in the cycle, this standard makes no adjustment.

**The cycle.** The current delinquency cycle is the one running from the agreement's delinquency date, the due date of the oldest unpaid period; a notice belongs to it when the notice's cycle runs from that same date. Notices of an earlier, closed cycle do not count.

**What is multiplied.** The multiplier acts on the late fee as kept within the late-fee ceiling of the class — the greater of the flat late fee and the percentage amount, no higher than the ceiling — so the multiplied fee may stand above the ceiling. The product is not rounded at this point; the fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Notices in the current cycle | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Notice of intent to tow (with or without a gate lockout notice) | 1.5 |
| Gate lockout notice only | 1.25 |
| Neither | no adjustment |

Hypothetical example: on a Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) whose fee within the ceiling is $45.00, a gate lockout notice in the current cycle gives $56.25, and a notice of intent to tow in the cycle gives $67.50 — above that class's $50.00 ceiling, because the ceiling applies before the multiplier. A gate lockout notice from a cycle that closed when the agreement was brought current earlier in the year does not count.
